'''Bloodvines''' were a carnivorous [[Plant/Legends|plant]] that grew on [[Abeloth's planet]] in [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]]. The plant consisted of resin-covered vines, and once a being was caught in the vines, the plant was able to react to the victim's movement by tightening around [[Limb/Legends|limbs]] in order to hinder and prevent movement. In [[44 ABY]], the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Vestara Khai]] was blinded by pollen and subsequently caught in a bloodvine that hung over the edge of a cliff. She cut herself free with her [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ben Skywalker]] [[Telekinesis/Legends|carried]] her back to the ground with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].
